references.text: Jesus heals many who are possessed by demons, demonstrating his power over evil, similar to the exorcism in Matthew 17:18.
Jesus rebukes an unclean spirit and commands it to leave a man, reflecting his authority over demons as shown in Matthew 17:18.
Jesus calms the storm by rebuking the wind, demonstrating his power over nature, parallel to his power over demons in Matthew 17:18.
Like the immediate healing in Matthew 17:18, Jesus here heals a boy possessed by a demon.
The Lord sends his word and heals, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' healing words in Matthew 17:18.
